mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% over 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases over the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) coupled with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) over the previous quarter signals a shift in demand from residential investment to broader economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline and GDPC1 rise in 1 quarter
regime_hint: economic expansion with reduced residential investment
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines and GDPC1 rises over the previous quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the previous month signals a monetary policy that is lagging inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease and CPIAUCSL increase in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases over the previous month.
